items.title: Senado aprova projeto que protege recursos do Fust contra contingenciamento

items.title: ANZ CEO Matos Warns of Global Jobs Crisis Without AI Rules

items.title: Nvidia’s CEO Change Won’t Derail AI Trade: Pepperstone
items.summary: Chris Weston, head of research at Pepperstone Group, said he doesn’t expect changes to Nvidia’s leadership to impact the outlook for the company. A new CEO will probably come with a deep knowledge of its business and will probably not change the rollout of products and direction of AI, he said. He spoke to Haidi Stroud-Watts on Asia Trade. (Source: Bloomberg)
